create_score_function_loss: create a score function surrogate loss for Monte Carlo gradient estimation with a distribution
create_pathwise_loss: create a pathwise derivative surrogate loss for differentiable sampling distributions
create_measure_valued_loss: create a measure valued surrogate loss with Jacobian dictionary for Normal distribution gradients
compute_measure_valued_mean_grad: compute measure valued gradient with respect to the mean of a Normal distribution
compute_measure_valued_scale_grad: compute measure valued gradient with respect to the scale of a Normal distribution
